title: Safe Offline SARS eFiling Simulation: Tax Registration & Profile Check
simulationNotice: OFFLINE TRAINING SIMULATION ONLY. Never enter real SARS credentials or personal ID numbers here.

fields.label: SARS Tax Reference Number (10 digits)
fields.hint: Enter a 10-digit training tax number starting with 0, 1, 2, 3, or 9 (e.g. 0123456789).

fields.label: South African ID Number (13 digits, training sample)
fields.hint: Enter a 13-digit training ID number with no spaces (e.g. 9901015009087).

fields.label: Taxpayer Type
fields.hint: Select 'Individual' for a personal salary taxpayer.

fields.label: eFiling Security Rule
fields.hint: Never share your eFiling password or One-Time PIN (OTP) with anyone.
